app_1_constraint: This is app 1. Per the charter, nothing here may be recorded as shared_candidate. Every capability implemented here is `local` until a SECOND app's production path uses the same contract. app 1 establishes; it does not reuse.
why: A basic text editor's market delivery is a windowed application. A CLI-only path would be an interface preference dressed as a product, which the charter forbids.
primary_workflow: open an existing UTF-8 text file from disk
find and replace within the document
reopen the application and the file, and observe the saved change
workflow_note: One workflow a person completes end to end. It is deliberately the WHOLE loop including restart, because persistence that is never reloaded is not persistence.
denominator_note: This is the fixed denominator for this slice. Splitting any of these into ten modules does not change it. Changing it requires an appended reason and both the original and revised verdict.
unsupported_scope: files that do not fit in memory
encodings other than UTF-8 on read (UTF-8 only; other encodings are refused with a named error rather than guessed)
unsupported_scope_note: Named before implementation so that moving a hard step here later is visible as workflow shrinkage rather than as scope clarification.

comparator.mssp_candidate: FMS/SCL/SMS/TMS/DMS split, with each domain capability as a TMS unit and no sibling imports
comparator.ordinary_alternative: a single-module editor with a conventional MVC or component split, no capability registry, no declared contracts
comparator.acceptance_equivalence: both would be judged by the same primary workflow acceptance
comparator.why_false: A design-only comparator can inform the decision. It cannot support a claim that MSSP produced a better outcome, because only one arm will be built. This slice's mssp_effect_verdict is therefore `unknown` by construction, and must be reported as such rather than omitted.

membership.policy: role-scoped, append-only, effective_from a commit. Independence keys on `implementation_builder` for the product tree only; authoring acceptance or attack harness does not contaminate it.
membership.declared_by_self_only: Each participant declares their own roles. Elenchos does not fill in anyone else's entry — a membership set written by one party is the FMS defect where one Node process wrote all three attestations (MSSP_Board #6).
membership.release_gate_requires: at least one independent attack pass by a party that is NOT an implementation_builder of the final product tree digest.

acceptance_protocol.usable: the primary workflow above, as a repeatable automated acceptance run. This is the same artifact as the usable gate — one artifact, two jobs.
acceptance_protocol.ui_complete: every capability in required_capabilities is reachable and completable from the GUI. The acceptance run drives the GUI, not an internal API.
acceptance_protocol.defects: all defects recorded with severity, the workflow or capability they are about, discoverer, discoverer's role at that commit, found and fixed commits, and status. Builder-found defects are recorded, not erased.
acceptance_protocol.release_claim_is_bounded: no open blocker or critical defect WITHIN the pre-registered workflow and scope, acceptance and regression re-run green, and at least one independent attack pass. It is not a claim that the program has few bugs in general.

slice_specific: dirty-guard bypass: close the window with unsaved changes by a route the acceptance run does not drive
encoding guess: feed a non-UTF-8 file and check it is refused by name rather than silently mangled
undo across save: undo past a save point and check the dirty state is not lost
reopen mismatch: the reopened file must be byte-identical to what was saved, line endings included

how_this_slice_could_come_out_badly: the GUI cannot complete one of the six domain capabilities without a CLI or internal call, and ui_complete fails
the reopened file is not byte-identical, and the workflow's last step fails
the MSSP split produces capabilities that are each one thin file with no independent meaning, which is module-splitting done to myself
the whole thing takes materially longer than nine days, which is evidence about the programme's schedule and must be reported rather than absorbed
stop_boundary: This document is the preregistration only. No implementation branch opens until Metron and Pragma have each declared their own membership roles and stated a position on this document. Neo has delegated the design decision to the three of us and will not review it.
